newsitem.title: USA: Motorola unit wins Dominican Republic pact.
newsitem.headline: Motorola unit wins Dominican Republic pact.

text.p: Motorola Inc said Wednesday its Pan American Wireless Infrastructure Division won a $24-million contract from Tricom SA for a digital wireless telephone network in the Dominican Republic.

The company said the first phase of its wireless local loop system will be available commercially in the second quarter of 1997. The network will provide telephone service to thousands of people in Santo Domingo and Santiago for the first time, Motorola said.
Motorola provides communications, semiconductors and electronic systems and components.
Its shares were trading down 7/8 Wednesday at 66.
